data.narrative:
World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li and team, is a Series A-stage AI & Software company that has raised $1.23B+. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR), with primary focus on 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers: Reflection AI ($25.0B), Together AI ($8.3B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $1.2B raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set produces a median valuation of $7.0B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $25.0B. The peer cohort reflects meaningful dispersion, reflecting heterogeneity in market expectations within the frontier AI sector.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $2.1B (low) to $8.0B (high), with a median of $4.7B. This range reflects tension between capital-raised benchmarking and peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the appropriate peer weighting given the wide $3.2B–$25.0B peer range, the applicability of stage-progression assumptions to a capital-intensive frontier AI company, and near-term commercial traction not present in the provided dataset.
